settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Global app preferences — applied immediately when saved.
settings.section_terminal_desc: Minimap, canvas controls, theme and default node sizes.
settings.section_dictation_desc: Shortcut and behavior for local dictation in text fields and terminals.
settings.dictation_hint: 100% offline transcription, runs locally in the app. The first time, the app downloads the voice models (~670 MB) once — it asks first. On macOS, Fn/Globe by itself is controlled by the system and cannot be captured by the app; use a combination such as Option+Space, Command+Shift+D, or an F1–F12 key.
settings.dictation_auto_submit_desc: After transcribing into a terminal, inserts the text and presses Enter. Regular text fields still only receive the transcript.
settings.section_voice_desc: Preserved local dictation and natural spoken replies in Portuguese, English or Spanish.
settings.tts_preview_failed: Could not play the voice preview.
settings.tts_preview_text_pt: Olá! Esta é a nova voz brasileira do Orkestrai.
settings.tts_preview_text_en: Hello! This is Orkestrai's new American English voice.
settings.tts_preview_text_es: ¡Hola! Esta es la nueva voz latinoamericana de Orkestrai.
settings.tts_preview_text_sidecar: Hello! This is a preview of the voice configured in Orkestrai.
settings.voice_hint: Parakeet still handles dictation. Supertonic 3 speaks replies locally in pt-BR, en-US or Latin American Spanish; the total download is ~670 MB and happens once.
settings.delete_model_desc: This frees up {size} of disk. Dictation and speech stop until you download it again (the app asks before downloading).
settings.delete_model_failed: Could not delete the voice model.
settings.section_shortcuts_desc: Quick reference for canvas and terminal shortcuts.
settings.section_presets_desc: Saved templates from your workspaces — offered when creating a new workspace.
settings.presets_empty: No presets yet. Build a team on the canvas and use "Save as preset" in the workspace editor.
settings.delete_preset_desc: Delete the preset "{name}"? Workspaces already created with it are not affected.
settings.section_updates_desc: The app checks for new versions on its own (at boot and every 6h) and shows the safe installation path for your platform — your data stays intact.
settings.update_unsupported: Automatic updates only exist in the installed app.
settings.update_error: Couldn't check right now — try again later.
settings.update_checking: Checking... if there is a new version, the app shows the next step.
settings.update_manual_available: Version {version} is available as a safe manual download.
settings.update_available: Version {version} was found and is downloading.
settings.language_desc: Interface in Portuguese, English or Spanish.
tool.note: Markdown note shared with agents (specs, briefings)
tool.diff: Diff: side-by-side comparison of what changed in the code — read-only, touches nothing

tool.shape: Shapes and visual annotations (rectangle, ellipse, arrow)

tool.routines: Routines: scheduled prompts that fire in any terminal
tool.roles: Roles: reusable agent responsibilities (travel with the repo)
tool.ports: Ports: local listeners linked to this workspace's Portals
tool.image: Reference image on the canvas (paste with Ctrl+V or pick a file)
canvas.empty: Create or select a workspace to open the canvas.
onboarding.welcome_body: A canvas where you build teams of AI agents doing real work on your project. Let's get started in 1 minute.
onboarding.ws_body: A workspace is the team: it points to the project folder and stores the canvas layout.
onboarding.pick_title: What do you want to do first?
onboarding.pick_body: Pick a use case and I'll guide you step by step until it actually works on the canvas.
tour.completed_body: You saw the use case working end to end. Pick another tour or explore on your own.

canvas.unload_desc: This stops the running terminals (Claude, Codex, Kimi, shell), freeing memory and CPU. The canvas layout stays saved and each agent resumes the conversation when the terminal reopens.

dlg.leader_desc: The leader recruits and dismisses agents on demand and distributes tasks from notes.

flow.empty_guide: Each Agent step talks to an agent and the reply becomes the next step's input (use input in double curly braces in the prompt). Approval pauses and waits for you.

flow.no_steps_hint: Add at least one step before running.

flow.sync_nothing_new: All connected agents are already in the steps.
canvas.del_nodes_desc: Deleted terminals lose their session: the conversation history and context go with it. Connected edges are removed too. You cannot undo this from the canvas.
